Complete [[The Eternal Grove]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Protect the [[Forever Tree]]s in the Eternal Grove.
* *BONUS* Keep all 12 [[Tree Singer]]s alive.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1000 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[The Eternal Grove#Walkthrough| The Eternal Grove]] mission.
